properties.name: Classic McEliece 6960119 (Binary Goppa Code-Based KEM)
properties.complexity_bounds: O(m * t * n) vector-matrix operations, n=6960, m=13, t=119
properties.algebraic_structure: Binary Goppa code over GF(2^13) defined by irreducible polynomial g(z) of degree t=119

properties.name: Additive FFT Patterson/Berlekamp-Massey Syndrome Decoding
properties.complexity_bounds: Time: O(t^2 + t log n) field operations over GF(2^13); Space: O(n)
properties.algebraic_basis: Locating error positions via root-finding of Goppa error locator polynomial sigma(z)
properties.algorithm_variant: Constant-time Additive Cantor FFT over extension field GF(2^13)

properties.name: AVX2 Extension with Vectorized Bit-Permutation Primitives
properties.throughput_bounds: 16 parallel 16-bit binary Galois Field arithmetic ops per 256-bit SIMD cycle

properties.microarchitectural_effect: Shuffle 16-bit/8-bit bytes in ymm2 according to control mask in ymm3/m256 for parallel GF(2^13) table lookups
Logical shift left of packed 16-bit integers in ymm2 by imm8 count for bit-slice polynomial alignments

properties.alignment_requirement: 32-byte boundary for aligned vector memory access (VMOVDQA)

properties.operation: Drives syndrome calculation and Goppa code error-locator polynomial solving during decapsulation

properties.vector_width: 16x 16-bit elements processed concurrently in bit-sliced Galois field arithmetic

properties.stage: Parallel 4-bit nibble multiplication table lookup stage within GF(2^13) field multiplication
Bit-sliced polynomial shift stage during additive Cantor FFT transformation

properties.access_pattern: Read/Write 256-bit vector registers containing 16 packed 16-bit GF(2^13) elements
Read/Write 256-bit vector registers adjusting coefficients prior to reduction modulo GF(2^13) generator
